title: Tzafnat, Daughter of Peniel the High Priest

paragraphs: [Gittin 58a](https://www.sefaria.org/Gittin.58a.14-15) relates that she was taken captive and her captor abused her all night. The next day he dressed her in seven garments and took her out to sell her, etc.[^1]

notes.text: Reish Lakish tells the story in the linked passage. It explains that Tzafnat bat Peniel was the daughter of the High Priest who served in the innermost sanctuary.
